name: profile-card
title: Profile card
description: Person card with banner, avatar, role, stats and an actions slot.
htmlExample:
<bef-profile-card name="Aarav Mehta" role="Senior engineer, Platform" location="Pune, India" status="Online" :stats='[{"label":"Projects","value":14},{"label":"Reports","value":5},{"label":"Years","value":"4.5"}]'>
  <bef-button variant="outline">Message</bef-button>
  <bef-button>View profile</bef-button>
</bef-profile-card>
